rules: A new matcher session starts in the centred default state; only a submitted result activates compact sticky mode.
Compact sticky search retains a visible micro-label, editable input, and right-side submit action.
Horizontal rails must not use gradient masks, pseudo-element edge veils, or clipped navigation hints.
Project and experiment headers present category and period as one metadata sentence separated by a vertical bar.
Timeline is not repeated inside experiment details.
Nested-dialog back navigation uses a visible text label and a minimum 44-pixel target; close remains the conventional × action.
